member.name: T:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper
member.summary: Provides static methods for generating unique identifiers in three strategies: DateTime-based (human-readable, single-machine), Base64URL GUID (distributed-safe, unsorted), and ULID (sortable, distributed-safe). Also provides conversion utilities between ULID strings and Guids.

member.name: F:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper._ulidOptions
member.summary: Generation options for ULID with monotonic increment to ensure within-millisecond ordering.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.ExtractTimestamp(System.String)
member.summary: Extracts the creation timestamp from a ULID string.
member.param: A 26-character ULID string in Crockford Base32 format.
member.returns: A representing the ULID's creation time in UTC.
member.exception: Thrown when is null, empty, or whitespace.
Thrown when is not a valid ULID string.
member.remarks: The ULID timestamp encodes Unix epoch milliseconds in UTC. The returned always has zero UTC offset.

example.code: DateTimeOffset timestamp = UniqueIdHelper.ExtractTimestamp("01HYX7QS3NP8M4KQJR5A7CVWKM"); // Returns the UTC time at which the ULID was generated.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.GenerateDateTimeId
member.summary: Generates a new unique ID based on the current UTC date/time with the format "yyyyMMddHHmmssfff". It ensures uniqueness by incrementing the time if multiple calls occur within the same millisecond.
member.returns: A unique 17-character ID string derived from the current date/time.
member.remarks: This method is thread-safe via an exclusive lock. The format is "yyyyMMddHHmmssfff", which provides human-readable, monotonically increasing IDs on a single machine. Not suitable for distributed systems — use instead.

example.code: string id = UniqueIdHelper.GenerateDateTimeId(); // Returns: "20260314120530123" (17-character timestamp string)

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.GenerateSortableUniqueStringId
member.summary: Generates a sortable unique 26-character ID string based on the ULID specification. ULIDs are chronologically sortable and distributed-safe, making them ideal for event sourcing, aggregate identifiers, and any use case requiring natural ordering.
member.returns: A 26-character Crockford Base32 encoded ULID string.
member.remarks: This method is thread-safe via monotonic increment options that guarantee within-millisecond ordering. ULIDs are suitable for event sourcing, aggregate identifiers, and any distributed system requiring natural time ordering.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.GenerateUniqueStringId
member.summary: Generates a unique 22-character ID string derived from a GUID encoded in Base64 URL-safe format.
member.remarks: This method is stateless and requires no locking. The character set is A-Za-z0-9, underscore, and hyphen (Base64 URL-safe). Use this method when a unique key is needed but sort order is not important.

example.code: string id = UniqueIdHelper.GenerateUniqueStringId(); // Returns: "a1B2c3D4e5F6g7H8i9J0kL" (22-char Base64 URL-safe)

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.ToGuid(System.String)
member.summary: Converts a ULID string to a .
member.remarks: The resulting Guid preserves identity but NOT lexicographic sort order. Two ULIDs that sort correctly as strings may not sort the same way as Guids due to Guid byte-order differences.
member.exception: Thrown when is null, empty, or whitespace.
Thrown when is not a valid ULID string.

example.code: Guid guid = UniqueIdHelper.ToGuid("01HYX7QS3NP8M4KQJR5A7CVWKM"); // Converts the ULID to a Guid preserving the 128-bit identity.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.ToSortableUniqueId(System.Guid)
member.summary: Converts a to a 26-character ULID string.
member.remarks: When called with a Guid not originally derived from a ULID (e.g., ), the result is a valid ULID string but its embedded timestamp is meaningless.

example.code: string ulid = UniqueIdHelper.ToSortableUniqueId(myGuid); // Returns a 26-character ULID string from the Guid's 128 bits.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Commons.UniqueIds.UniqueIdHelper.CrockfordBase32Pattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$
Options:
RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Za-hjkmnp-tv-z\u212A] exactly 26 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
